query:
SELECT id, triage_status, title, title_orig, summary, gists_json, canonical_url, publisher, published_at,
              enrichment_status, editorial_brand, content_family, source_id, decision_route, intake_meta_json
       FROM source_items WHERE route = ? AND dedupe_key = ?

SELECT id, title, title_orig, summary, gists_json, enrichment_status
     FROM source_items WHERE route = ? AND dedupe_key = ?

SELECT id, route, title, title_orig, summary
             FROM source_items
             WHERE triage_status = 'inbox'
               AND enrichment_status IN ('pending', 'failed')
               AND COALESCE(fetched_at, updated_at) >= ? ORDER BY fetched_at ASC
            LIMIT ?

SELECT triage_status AS status, archive_kind AS archive_kind, COUNT(*) AS c
       FROM source_items WHERE route = ?
       GROUP BY triage_status, archive_kind

INSERT INTO source_items
       (id, feed_id, route, channel_id, title, title_orig, summary, gists_json,
        canonical_url, publisher, published_at, triage_status, dedupe_key, enrichment_status,
        editorial_brand, content_family, source_id, decision_route, intake_meta_json)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'inbox', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

SELECT i.*, e.doi, e.pmid, e.pmcid, e.finding, e.limitation, e.study_type
       FROM source_items i
       LEFT JOIN evidence_cards e ON e.source_item_id = i.id
       WHERE i.route = ? AND i.triage_status = ? AND COALESCE(i.fetched_at, i.published_at, i.updated_at) >= ? AND i.channel_id = ? AND i.title NOT LIKE '%@%' AND LENGTH(TRIM(i.title)) >= 12 AND COALESCE(i.decision_route, '') != 'REJECTED_LEGACY' ORDER BY COALESCE(i.fetched_at, i.published_at) DESC LIMIT ?

SELECT i.*, e.doi, e.pmid, e.pmcid, e.finding, e.limitation, e.study_type
       FROM source_items i
       LEFT JOIN evidence_cards e ON e.source_item_id = i.id
       WHERE i.route = ? AND i.triage_status = ? AND COALESCE(i.fetched_at, i.published_at, i.updated_at) >= ? ORDER BY COALESCE(i.fetched_at, i.published_at) DESC LIMIT ?
INSERT INTO source_routes (id, source_item_id, route, channel_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
SELECT id, doi, pmid, pmcid, finding, limitation, study_type FROM evidence_cards WHERE source_item_id = ?

UPDATE source_items
       SET title = ?,
           title_orig = ?,
           summary = ?,
           gists_json = ?,
           enrichment_status = 'done',
           enrichment_json = ?,
           enrichment_error = NULL,
           enriched_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'),
           updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
       WHERE id = ?
SELECT feed_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM source_items WHERE triage_status = 'inbox' GROUP BY feed_id
SELECT id FROM source_items WHERE route = ? AND lower(title) = lower(?) AND triage_status != 'trash' LIMIT ?
DELETE FROM source_items WHERE id = ?
SELECT enrichment_status AS s FROM source_items WHERE id = ?

SELECT * FROM source_feeds WHERE route = ? AND enabled = 1 AND endpoint_url IS NOT NULL AND endpoint_url != 'null' AND (last_error IS NULL OR last_fetched_at IS NULL OR last_fetched_at < ?) AND id NOT IN ('who-newsroom', 'news-who-newsroom-whole') ORDER BY COALESCE(last_fetched_at, '1970-01-01') ASC, id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
SELECT id, channel_id FROM source_feeds WHERE id = ? AND enabled = 1

SELECT * FROM source_feeds WHERE route = ? AND enabled = 1 AND endpoint_url IS NOT NULL AND endpoint_url != 'null' AND (last_error IS NULL OR last_fetched_at IS NULL OR last_fetched_at < ?) AND id NOT IN ('europe-pmc-batch', 'research-europe-pmc-rest', 'research-pubmed-eutilities', 'research-crossref-rest-api', 'research-openalex-api', 'research-clinicaltrials-gov-api-v2') ORDER BY COALESCE(last_fetched_at, '1970-01-01') ASC, id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
SELECT id FROM evidence_cards WHERE source_item_id = ?

SELECT triage_status AS status, archive_kind AS archive_kind, COUNT(*) AS c
       FROM source_items WHERE route = ? AND channel_id = ? AND COALESCE(decision_route, '') != 'REJECTED_LEGACY' AND title NOT LIKE '%@%' AND LENGTH(TRIM(title)) >= 12
       GROUP BY triage_status, archive_kind

UPDATE source_feeds
       SET last_fetched_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'),
           last_ok_items = CASE WHEN ? > 0 THEN ? ELSE COALESCE(last_ok_items, 0) END,
           last_error = ?,
           fetch_attempts = COALESCE(fetch_attempts, 0) + 1
       WHERE id = ?

SELECT triage_status AS status, archive_kind AS archive_kind, COUNT(*) AS c
       FROM source_items WHERE route = ? AND COALESCE(channel_id, '') != 'hekimler-toplulugu'
       GROUP BY triage_status, archive_kind
SELECT source_id, last_run_at FROM hekimler_source_telemetry

INSERT INTO evidence_cards (id, source_item_id, finding, limitation)
           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
SELECT brief_id FROM approved_briefs WHERE source_item_id = ?

SELECT * FROM source_feeds WHERE route = ? AND enabled = 1 AND endpoint_url IS NOT NULL AND endpoint_url != 'null' AND (last_error IS NULL OR last_fetched_at IS NULL OR last_fetched_at < ?) AND (last_fetched_at IS NULL OR datetime(last_fetched_at, '+' || COALESCE(poll_minutes, 360) || ' minutes') <= datetime('now')) AND id NOT IN ('europe-pmc-batch', 'research-europe-pmc-rest', 'research-pubmed-eutilities', 'research-crossref-rest-api', 'research-openalex-api', 'research-clinicaltrials-gov-api-v2') ORDER BY COALESCE(last_fetched_at, '1970-01-01') ASC, id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT * FROM source_feeds WHERE route = ? AND enabled = 1 AND endpoint_url IS NOT NULL AND endpoint_url != 'null' AND (last_error IS NULL OR last_fetched_at IS NULL OR last_fetched_at < ?) AND (last_fetched_at IS NULL OR datetime(last_fetched_at, '+' || COALESCE(poll_minutes, 360) || ' minutes') <= datetime('now')) AND id NOT IN ('who-newsroom', 'news-who-newsroom-whole') ORDER BY COALESCE(last_fetched_at, '1970-01-01') ASC, id LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
SELECT dedupe_key FROM source_items WHERE route = 'tip-ogrencileri' AND channel_id = ? AND canonical_url = ? LIMIT ?
UPDATE evidence_cards SET finding = ?, limitation = ? WHERE id = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) AS c FROM source_feeds WHERE route = ? AND enabled = 1

UPDATE source_feeds
       SET last_fetched_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'),
           last_ok_items = ?,
           last_error = NULL,
           fetch_attempts = COALESCE(fetch_attempts, 0) + 1
       WHERE id = ?
         AND (last_fetched_at IS NULL OR last_fetched_at < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now', '-6 hours')
              OR last_error IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(last_ok_items, -1) != ?)
SELECT * FROM source_feeds WHERE id = 'tip-radar-adapter' AND enabled = 1

INSERT INTO evidence_cards
       (id, source_item_id, doi, pmid, pmcid, finding, limitation, study_type)
       VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

UPDATE source_feeds
       SET last_fetched_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'),
           last_ok_items = ?,
           last_error = NULL,
           fetch_attempts = COALESCE(fetch_attempts, 0) + 1
       WHERE id = 'tip-radar-adapter'
         AND (last_fetched_at IS NULL OR last_fetched_at < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now', '-6 hours')
              OR last_error IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(last_ok_items, -1) != ?)

SELECT i.*, e.doi, e.pmid, e.pmcid, e.finding, e.limitation, e.study_type
     FROM source_items i
     LEFT JOIN evidence_cards e ON e.source_item_id = i.id
     WHERE i.id = ?

SELECT id, label, route, channel_id, transport, endpoint_url, poll_minutes, enabled, external_ref,
                          last_fetched_at, last_ok_items, last_error
                   FROM source_feeds WHERE route = ? AND enabled = 1 ORDER BY route, label
SELECT * FROM source_feeds WHERE id = ? AND enabled = 1

UPDATE source_items SET canonical_url = ?, publisher = ?, published_at = ?,
           editorial_brand = COALESCE(?, editorial_brand),
           content_family = COALESCE(?, content_family),
           source_id = COALESCE(?, source_id),
           decision_route = COALESCE(?, decision_route),
           intake_meta_json = COALESCE(?, intake_meta_json),
           updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
           WHERE id = ?

SELECT id FROM source_items
     WHERE triage_status IN ('trash', 'done') AND updated_at < ?
     LIMIT ?

SELECT source_id, last_success_at, last_content_hash, failure_count, zero_accept_streak, coverage_status
     FROM hekimler_source_telemetry WHERE source_id = ?

INSERT INTO hekimler_source_telemetry
     (source_id, activation_state, last_success_at, last_content_hash, last_item_timestamp,
      failure_count, source_health, last_run_at, last_operator_status, updated_at,
      coverage_status, coverage_reason, zero_accept_streak, last_accepted_count, last_discarded_count, last_item_count)
     VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), ?, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'),
             ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
     ON CONFLICT(source_id) DO UPDATE SET
       activation_state = excluded.activation_state,
       last_success_at = COALESCE(excluded.last_success_at, hekimler_source_telemetry.last_success_at),
       last_content_hash = COALESCE(excluded.last_content_hash, hekimler_source_telemetry.last_content_hash),
       last_item_timestamp = COALESCE(excluded.last_item_timestamp, hekimler_source_telemetry.last_item_timestamp),
       failure_count = excluded.failure_count,
       source_health = excluded.source_health,
       last_run_at = excluded.last_run_at,
       last_operator_status = excluded.last_operator_status,
       updated_at = excluded.updated_at,
       coverage_status = COALESCE(excluded.coverage_status, hekimler_source_telemetry.coverage_status),
       coverage_reason = excluded.coverage_reason,
       zero_accept_streak = excluded.zero_accept_streak,
       last_accepted_count = excluded.last_accepted_count,
       last_discarded_count = excluded.last_discarded_count,
       last_item_count = excluded.last_item_count

UPDATE source_feeds SET last_fetched_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'),
     last_ok_items = ?, last_error = ?, fetch_attempts = COALESCE(fetch_attempts, 0) + 1
     WHERE id = ?
SELECT id, channel_id, label, last_ok_items FROM source_feeds WHERE id = ? AND enabled = 1

SELECT feed_id, COUNT(*) as n30, MIN(fetched_at) as earliest, MAX(fetched_at) as latest FROM source_items WHERE fetched_at > datetime('now','-30 days') AND route IN ('kaduse-news','kaduse-research','tip-ogrencileri') GROUP BY feed_id
UPDATE source_feeds SET last_fetched_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), last_ok_items = ?, last_error = NULL, fetch_attempts = COALESCE(fetch_attempts, 0) + 1 WHERE id = ?
SELECT feed_id, COUNT(*) as n, MIN(fetched_at) as first_seen, MAX(fetched_at) as last_seen FROM source_items WHERE feed_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY feed_id

WITH stats AS (SELECT f.id, COUNT(i.id) AS items, COUNT(DISTINCT substr(i.fetched_at,1,10)) AS days FROM source_feeds f LEFT JOIN source_items i ON i.feed_id = f.id WHERE f.enabled = 1 AND f.route IN ('kaduse-news','kaduse-research') GROUP BY f.id) SELECT CASE WHEN days >= 3 AND items * 1.0 / days >= 8 THEN 'hourly' WHEN days >= 3 THEN 'daily' WHEN days = 2 THEN 'weekly' WHEN items = 0 THEN 'monthly' ELSE 'monthly' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS n FROM stats GROUP BY 1

UPDATE evidence_cards SET doi = ?, pmid = ?, pmcid = ?, finding = ?, limitation = ?, study_type = ?
         WHERE id = ?
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM source_items WHERE summary LIKE '%geleneksel tıp için daha fazla araştırma%' OR gists_json LIKE '%geleneksel tıp için daha fazla araştırma%'

SELECT f.id, f.route, f.label, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source_items si WHERE si.feed_id = f.id) as n, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(t, ' ||| ') FROM (SELECT title as t FROM source_items si WHERE si.feed_id = f.id ORDER BY fetched_at DESC LIMIT ?)) as sample_titles FROM source_feeds f WHERE f.route IN ('kaduse-news','kaduse-research') AND f.enabled = 1 ORDER BY f.route, f.id

UPDATE source_items SET title = ?, title_orig = ?, summary = ?, gists_json = ?,
         canonical_url = ?, publisher = ?, published_at = ?, enrichment_status = ?,
         editorial_brand = COALESCE(?, editorial_brand),
         content_family = COALESCE(?, content_family),
         source_id = COALESCE(?, source_id),
         decision_route = COALESCE(?, decision_route),
         intake_meta_json = COALESCE(?, intake_meta_json),
         updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
         WHERE id = ?

SELECT f.route, f.id, f.label, f.poll_minutes, f.last_fetched_at, COUNT(i.id) AS items, COUNT(DISTINCT substr(i.fetched_at,1,10)) AS seen_days, SUM(CASE WHEN i.published_at GLOB '????-??-??*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS iso_n FROM source_feeds f LEFT JOIN source_items i ON i.feed_id = f.id WHERE f.enabled = 1 AND f.route IN ('kaduse-news','kaduse-research') GROUP BY f.id ORDER BY f.route, items DESC
SELECT id FROM source_items WHERE summary LIKE '%geleneksel tıp için daha fazla araştırma%' OR gists_json LIKE '%geleneksel tıp için daha fazla araştırma%'

SELECT feed_id, COUNT(*) as n, COUNT(DISTINCT published_at) as distinct_dates, MIN(published_at) as earliest, MAX(published_at) as latest FROM source_items WHERE feed_id IS NOT NULL AND published_at IS NOT NULL GROUP BY feed_id

SELECT CASE WHEN published_at IS NULL OR published_at = '' THEN 'empty' WHEN published_at GLOB '????-??-??*' THEN 'iso' WHEN published_at GLOB '???? ??? *' THEN 'mon-name' ELSE 'other' END AS fmt, COUNT(*) AS n FROM source_items GROUP BY 1

WITH stats AS (SELECT f.id, COUNT(i.id) AS items, COUNT(DISTINCT substr(i.fetched_at,1,10)) AS ingest_days, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.published_at GLOB '????-??-??*' AND substr(i.published_at,1,10) BETWEEN '2026-09-02' AND '2026-09-24' THEN substr(i.published_at,1,10) END) AS pub_days, SUM(CASE WHEN i.published_at GLOB '????-??-??*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS iso_n FROM source_feeds f LEFT JOIN source_items i ON i.feed_id = f.id WHERE f.enabled = 1 AND f.route IN ('kaduse-news','kaduse-research') GROUP BY f.id), scored AS (SELECT id, items, CASE WHEN iso_n >= 5 THEN pub_days ELSE ingest_days END AS signal_days FROM stats) SELECT id, items, signal_days FROM scored WHERE signal_days >= 5 AND items * 1.0 / signal_days >= 8 ORDER BY items DESC

WITH stats AS (SELECT f.id, COUNT(i.id) AS items, COUNT(DISTINCT substr(i.fetched_at,1,10)) AS ingest_days, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN i.published_at GLOB '????-??-??*' AND substr(i.published_at,1,10) BETWEEN '2026-09-02' AND '2026-09-24' THEN substr(i.published_at,1,10) END) AS pub_days, SUM(CASE WHEN i.published_at GLOB '????-??-??*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS iso_n FROM source_feeds f LEFT JOIN source_items i ON i.feed_id = f.id WHERE f.enabled = 1 AND f.route IN ('kaduse-news','kaduse-research') GROUP BY f.id), scored AS (SELECT id, items, CASE WHEN iso_n >= 5 THEN pub_days ELSE ingest_days END AS signal_days FROM stats) SELECT CASE WHEN signal_days >= 5 AND items * 1.0 / MAX(signal_days,1) >= 8 THEN 'hourly' WHEN signal_days >= 4 THEN 'daily' WHEN signal_days >= 2 THEN 'weekly' ELSE 'monthly' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS n FROM scored GROUP BY 1

WITH stats AS (SELECT f.route, f.id, COUNT(i.id) AS items, COUNT(DISTINCT substr(i.fetched_at,1,10)) AS days FROM source_feeds f LEFT JOIN source_items i ON i.feed_id = f.id WHERE f.enabled = 1 AND f.route IN ('kaduse-news','kaduse-research') GROUP BY f.id) SELECT route, id, items, days FROM stats WHERE days >= 3 AND items * 1.0 / days >= 8 ORDER BY route, items DESC

SELECT id, channel_id, label, last_ok_items FROM source_feeds WHERE id = ? AND enabled = 1 AND (last_fetched_at IS NULL OR datetime(last_fetched_at, '+' || COALESCE(poll_minutes, 1440) || ' minutes') <= datetime('now'))
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM source_items WHERE (summary LIKE '%geleneksel t%p%' OR summary LIKE '%traditional medicine%') AND (summary LIKE '%DS%' OR summary LIKE '%WHO%')

WITH dated AS (SELECT feed_id, substr(published_at,1,10) AS d FROM source_items WHERE published_at GLOB '????-??-??*' AND substr(published_at,1,10) >= '2025-01-01' AND substr(published_at,1,10) <= '2026-09-24'), days AS (SELECT DISTINCT feed_id, d FROM dated), gaps AS (SELECT feed_id, julianday(d) - julianday(LAG(d) OVER (PARTITION BY feed_id ORDER BY d)) AS gap FROM days) SELECT feed_id, COUNT(*) AS gaps, ROUND(AVG(gap),2) AS avg_gap_days, ROUND(MIN(gap),2) AS min_gap, ROUND(MAX(gap),2) AS max_gap FROM gaps WHERE gap IS NOT NULL AND gap > 0 GROUP BY feed_id ORDER BY avg_gap_days
SELECT canonical_url, source_id, intake_meta_json FROM source_items WHERE title LIKE '%Erişkin İnfluenza%' LIMIT ?
SELECT * FROM source_feeds WHERE id = ? AND enabled = 1 AND (last_fetched_at IS NULL OR datetime(last_fetched_at, '+' || COALESCE(poll_minutes, 360) || ' minutes') <= datetime('now'))
SELECT * FROM source_feeds WHERE id IN ('who-newsroom', 'news-who-newsroom-whole') AND enabled = 1 LIMIT ?

SELECT source_id, last_success_at, source_health, coverage_status, last_item_timestamp,
                  last_accepted_count, last_discarded_count, last_item_count, failure_count
           FROM hekimler_source_telemetry ORDER BY source_id
SELECT feed_id, title, canonical_url, fetched_at FROM source_items WHERE fetched_at > datetime('now','-5 minutes') ORDER BY fetched_at DESC LIMIT ?
UPDATE source_items SET triage_status = 'hold', updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?

WITH dated AS (SELECT feed_id, substr(published_at,1,10) AS d FROM source_items WHERE published_at GLOB '????-??-??*' AND substr(published_at,1,10) >= '2026-09-02' AND substr(published_at,1,10) <= '2026-09-24'), days AS (SELECT DISTINCT feed_id, d FROM dated), gaps AS (SELECT feed_id, julianday(d) - julianday(LAG(d) OVER (PARTITION BY feed_id ORDER BY d)) AS gap FROM days) SELECT g.feed_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM days d WHERE d.feed_id = g.feed_id) AS pub_days, COUNT(*) AS gaps, ROUND(AVG(g.gap),2) AS avg_gap FROM gaps g WHERE g.gap IS NOT NULL AND g.gap > 0 GROUP BY g.feed_id ORDER BY avg_gap

UPDATE source_items
     SET triage_status = ?,
         archive_kind = ?,
         updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
     WHERE id = ?

SELECT f.id, f.route, f.label, f.last_ok_items, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source_items si WHERE si.feed_id = f.id) as total_items, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source_items si WHERE si.feed_id = f.id AND si.fetched_at > datetime('now','-30 days')) as items_30d FROM source_feeds f WHERE f.route IN ('kaduse-news','kaduse-research') AND f.enabled = 1 ORDER BY items_30d ASC, total_items ASC
SELECT title, summary FROM source_items WHERE title LIKE '%Princess Diana%'

SELECT source_id, last_success_at, source_health, coverage_status, last_item_timestamp,
                  last_accepted_count, last_discarded_count, last_item_count, failure_count, poll_minutes
           FROM hekimler_source_telemetry ORDER BY source_id
SELECT feed_id, title, canonical_url FROM source_items WHERE canonical_url LIKE '%nice.org.uk/news/articles%'
SELECT * FROM source_items WHERE title LIKE '%Princess Diana%'

SELECT source_id, title FROM source_items WHERE source_id IN ('trthaber_saglik','sabah_saglik','euronews_tr_saglik','sondakika_saglik','saglikpersonelihaberi_net','ahaber_saglik','dha_saglik_yasam','gazeteoksijen_saglik','titck_announcements_general') LIMIT ?
SELECT source_id, canonical_url, intake_meta_json FROM source_items WHERE title LIKE '%MANİSA%SİLAHLI%'
DELETE FROM source_items WHERE feed_id='news-nice-healthtech-scoped' AND canonical_url NOT LIKE '%bing.com%'
SELECT id FROM source_items WHERE (summary LIKE '%geleneksel t%p%' OR summary LIKE '%traditional medicine%') AND (summary LIKE '%DS%' OR summary LIKE '%WHO%')
SELECT * FROM source_feeds WHERE id = 'research-pubmed-eutilities' AND enabled = 1
SELECT * FROM source_feeds WHERE id IN ('europe-pmc-batch', 'research-europe-pmc-rest') AND enabled = 1 LIMIT ?
SELECT id, feed_id, title, summary, gists_json FROM source_items WHERE title LIKE '%Erişkin İnfluenza%' LIMIT ?

SELECT source_id, last_success_at, source_health, coverage_status, last_item_timestamp,
                  last_accepted_count, last_discarded_count, last_item_count, failure_count, poll_minutes,
                  zero_accept_streak
           FROM hekimler_source_telemetry ORDER BY source_id
SELECT id, label, poll_minutes, route FROM source_feeds WHERE enabled=1 AND route IN ('kaduse-news','kaduse-research') ORDER BY route, poll_minutes, id

SELECT publisher, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT substr(published_at,1,10)) AS iso_days FROM source_items WHERE feed_id = 'hekimler-phase1-canary' AND published_at GLOB '????-??-??*' AND substr(published_at,1,10) >= '2026-09-01' GROUP BY publisher ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT ?

SELECT * FROM source_feeds WHERE id IN ('europe-pmc-batch', 'research-europe-pmc-rest') AND enabled = 1 AND (last_fetched_at IS NULL OR datetime(last_fetched_at, '+' || COALESCE(poll_minutes, 360) || ' minutes') <= datetime('now')) LIMIT ?

INSERT INTO editorial_decisions (id, source_item_id, action, from_status, to_status, actor)
     VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

UPDATE source_feeds SET last_fetched_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), last_ok_items = ?, last_error = NULL, fetch_attempts = COALESCE(fetch_attempts, 0) + 1 WHERE id IN ('who-newsroom', 'news-who-newsroom-whole')

WITH stats AS (SELECT source_id, COUNT(*) AS items, COUNT(DISTINCT substr(fetched_at,1,10)) AS days FROM source_items WHERE route = 'tip-ogrencileri' AND source_id IS NOT NULL AND source_id != '' GROUP BY source_id) SELECT CASE WHEN days >= 3 AND items * 1.0 / days >= 8 THEN 'hourly' WHEN days >= 3 THEN 'daily' WHEN days = 2 THEN 'weekly' ELSE 'monthly' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS n FROM stats GROUP BY 1
SELECT id, title FROM source_items WHERE route='kaduse-news' AND fetched_at > datetime('now','-3 days') ORDER BY fetched_at DESC LIMIT ?
SELECT title FROM source_items WHERE route='tip-ogrencileri' ORDER BY fetched_at DESC LIMIT ?

INSERT INTO approved_briefs
     (brief_id, source_item_id, route, channel_id, payload_json, handoff_status, handoff_detail, approved_at, approved_by)
     VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

DELETE FROM source_items WHERE feed_id='news-swissmedic-news-scoped' AND (canonical_url LIKE '%/legal%' OR canonical_url LIKE '%/contacts/%' OR canonical_url LIKE '%/input/%' OR canonical_url LIKE '%/jobs.html' OR canonical_url LIKE '%/services/egov-portal%' OR canonical_url = 'https://www.swissmedic.ch/swissmedic/en/home.html' OR canonical_url LIKE '%/news/mitteilungen.html' OR canonical_url LIKE '%/news/updates%' OR canonical_url LIKE '%/publications/swissmedic-journal%')
SELECT source_id, COUNT(*) as n FROM source_items WHERE route='tip-ogrencileri' AND source_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY source_id

DELETE FROM source_items WHERE feed_id='news-swissmedic-news-scoped' AND canonical_url NOT LIKE '%fetchrss%' AND canonical_url NOT LIKE '%swissmedic.ch/swissmedic/en/home/%medicines%' AND title IN ('Medical devices','Complementary & herbal medicines','Veterinary medicines','Human medicines','Latest News')

UPDATE source_items
       SET enrichment_status = 'skipped',
           enrichment_json = ?,
           enrichment_error = NULL,
           enriched_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'),
           updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')
       WHERE id = ?

SELECT * FROM source_feeds WHERE id = 'research-pubmed-eutilities' AND enabled = 1 AND (last_fetched_at IS NULL OR datetime(last_fetched_at, '+' || COALESCE(poll_minutes, 360) || ' minutes') <= datetime('now'))
